title: Cross level: rails tilted with the road

options: the rails tilt across like this
level: the road tilts, the rails do not
findings.info: near Palmovka: the road falls across both tracks here and the build tilts the rails with it, the left rail up to 41 mm lower (2.7 % across the gauge) for 26 m (s 3978-4004). Do the rails tilt across here in reality?
